punchline: A pile of 424 different work gloves on a boardroom table did what a spreadsheet couldn't.
thirty_sec: In Switch, Chip and Dan Heath tell how Jon Stegner wanted his company to fix wasteful purchasing. An intern found the factories bought 424 kinds of work gloves, often the same glove at different prices. Stegner piled them all, with price tags, on the boardroom table. Stunned executives changed course. The lesson: change often follows see-feel-change, not analyze-think-change.
question: What would make people feel the problem you're trying to fix?
